pdf-to-text.formula:
words = number of whitespace-separated tokens
characters = total characters including spaces

Example check: 180 + 220 = 400 words; 1,050 + 1,300 = 2,350 characters.

limitations: Scanned or image-only PDFs have no text layer, so nothing can be extracted without OCR.
Complex multi-column layouts may extract in an unexpected reading order.
Very large PDFs (100+ pages) can be slow to process and may use significant browser memory.
Password-protected PDFs that require a password prompt cannot be read.

pdf-to-text.workedExample:
A 2-page PDF:
Page 1 holds 180 words and 1,050 characters.
Page 2 holds 220 words and 1,300 characters.
Total words: 180 + 220 = 400.
Total characters: 1,050 + 1,300 = 2,350.
The tool shows exactly these totals and downloads all 400 words as one .txt file.
